answer_1.quote: We systematically measure the efficacy of various jailbreak methods across nine LLMs and conduct comprehensive ablation studies.
answer_1.outputs: Responses generated by LLMs to forbidden questions under jailbreak attacks

answer_2.quote: We adopt attack success rate (ASR) as our evaluation metric. ASR is the ratio of successful jailbreak queries n to total queries m (ASR = n/m).

answer_3.quote: Thus, we employ GPT-4-Turbo (gpt-4-turbo) as our judging model to label the responses from three aspects, aiming to evaluate the responses comprehensively and reduce misclassification.

answer_4.quote: We randomly select 640 responses, which are then independently labeled by three different annotators.
answer_4.guideline: Annotators labeled responses based on three criteria: non-rephrased, provision of requested information, and relevance to question.
